# What the document-wide name sweep recovers

The same detector over the same corpus twice: once with the sweep off, once
with it on. Every person the page detectors find licenses the other whole-word
occurrences of their name parts across the rest of the document, which is the
trick `sever.decide.placeholders` already used for the outbound boundary.

The columns are paired per name profile, so each pair isolates the sweep and
the pairs together show where it matters. It should do almost nothing on
`plain`, whose names the model already knows, and most on the profiles whose
names it does not.
